core_obligations: Base n = 2 (proof lines 1957-1962): pull the cube relation along x -> (x, x, -x), obtaining L^3 (x) [-1]^*L = [2]^*L.
Induction step (proof lines 1964-1976): pull the cube relation along x -> (x, x, [n-1]x) to get [n+1]^*L (x) L^2 (x) [n-1]^*L = [2]^*L (x) [n]^*L (x) [n]^*L.
Arithmetic (proof lines 1976-1983): substitute the induction formulas for [2]^*L, [n]^*L, [n-1]^*L and cancel in the Picard group, matching the exponents n(n+1)/2 and n(n-1)/2.
proof_roadmap: Prove the n = 2 case by the first pullback (proof lines 1957-1962).

Cancel in Pic to finish (proof lines 1976-1983).
